knowledge soundness or soundness bound for the exact interactive product protocol against quantum dishonest provers
HVZK/computational ZK/statistical soundness requirements selected per proof kind, plus simulator composition for NumiSealZK
numeric bound on adversarial quantum random-oracle queries Q_H for the selected hardware/product threat model

proof that proof-kind/domain separation prevents cross-kind transcript collision and malleability under the accepted envelope set

proofKindFit.candidateFamily: multi-round public-coin plus ZK simulator composition

lossInterface.selectedDepthExpression: epsilon_fs_transform(depth=1) <= max_kind(((2*Q_H+n_kind+1)^(2*n_kind) / n_kind!) * epsilon_interactive_kind + n_kind! / 2^256 + epsilon_precondition_kind)
lossInterface.recursivePromotionExpression: epsilon_fs_transform(depth=d) <= d * max_kind(((2*Q_H+n_kind+1)^(2*n_kind) / n_kind!) * epsilon_interactive_kind + n_kind! / 2^256 + epsilon_precondition_kind)
